source: dogfood C17 held-out GIFT-1 (#271): council ledgers in .factory/state/council/memory, decisions shard, round-1 critic-sol output of the third PR check sitting; file versions from the recorded git trees

webappRound1.text: The new gift message form row (text input plus Save button) cannot shrink at phone width, so .catalog-item-content and the whole cart line grow past the viewport. The page scrolls sideways and the Save button and line totals are clipped.
webappRound1.fix: In CartPage.razor.css add `.cart-items .cart-item .catalog-item-content { min-width: 0; }`, and let `.gift-message-form` wrap (flex-wrap: wrap) or give its text input width:100% so the form fits within 375px.

webappRound1.text: A failed remote write replaces the displayed saved message with text the server rejected. The error response contradicts the persisted basket until reload.
webappRound1.fix: Build the update without mutating the displayed BasketItem, or restore its original message on failure. Keep attempted text in the editor while retaining the actual saved message under the product name.

prCheck1.text: Successful save reported as failed when the basket reload fails
prCheck1.fix: In SaveGiftMessageAsync, set giftMessageSaveFailed only when Basket.SetGiftMessageAsync throws. Reload the basket in a separate step with its own handling, so a reload failure never reports the save as failed and never shows the stale message as current.

prCheck2.text: Mobile ClientApp's older basket.proto silently wipes stored gift messages
prCheck2.fix: Add `string gift_message = 7;` to src/ClientApp/Services/Basket/Protos/basket.proto, and have ClientApp's BasketService carry each item's gift message through UpdateBasketAsync (store it on the ClientApp basket item from GetBasket and send it back). Alternatively, have Basket.API keep a stored item's existing message when the update omits the field, but only if the WebApp's clear path stays distinguishable. Add a test for the chosen approach.

decisions.reason: Saving changes message text without ticket authorization

solSitting3.title: Preserve the shopper's submitted text
solSitting3.detail: Saving "  For Sam  " stores "For Sam", and submitting whitespace-only text clears an existing message. No ticket line requests trimming or treating nonempty whitespace as deletion. AC2 requires showing the submitted message; AC3 defines clearing the text. The implementer's Decisions section does not authorize these additional behaviors.
solSitting3.requirement: Council scope rule; story AC2 and AC3 at .factory/state/board/GIFT-1/story.md:10-11.
solSitting3.fix: Preserve nonempty submitted text through storage and rendering; use null or an empty string for clearing. Apply the existing length validation to the preserved text.
